author: GB Patch Games
title: Guest artists wanted for visual novel
content: The call does not close! This is just a reminder that we are actively looking for artists :) Original call: We’re hiring guest artists! GB Patch Games is looking for artists (who specialize in digital art) for monthly guest art and upcoming celebrations for the Early Access release of Our Life: Now & Forever. Interested in commissioning for us? Reach out on any of our socials via DMs with your rates and a portfolio (or a few examples of your work). You can also email support@gbpatchgames.com with your information.

title: Paid 3D artist and animator for game
content: Looking for a 3D Artist & Animator for my personal game project! It’s a paid project and I’m looking for someone who can work with me on bringing the game to life. Interested? DM me your portfolio! 📩
